params.arch_note: ByT5/mt5/T5 auto-detected via config.is_encoder_decoder; causal LMs supported

surface._doc: Attestation that prompts derived from corpus text never leave this machine (local-processing rule). Required true whenever verbatim/extraction probes with corpus prefixes are enabled. For probing a served runtime, use adapter 'http' with base_url pointing at a loopback/self-hosted surface and keep local=true.

corpus._doc: Normalized protected-corpus shards: sentence-per-line UTF-8 text files. Paths come from the environment per the data-access contract; nothing is copied into any repo.

verbatim._doc: Floor fixed by the original license agreement's extraction clause; only tighten. n_probes sampled continuations per run.

mia._doc: Owner-set tolerances (defaults documented in README.md). AUC gate: |AUC-0.5| <= auc_tolerance. Success-rate gate: <= success_rate_tolerance. Without a mia.reference block the naive statistics gate; WITH one, the calibrated statistics gate (method of record).

extraction._doc: Add synthetic canaries here if the training run embedded any; defaults ship generic + corpus-prefix templates.

wordnet._doc: Reference-resource synset file (JSONL: id, pos, gloss, example, lemma[, relations]).
